default.description: Core window/webview/event access for the operator (main) window, the audience projection window and the detached debug window. Custom app commands are not ACL-gated, so only core APIs are listed here.

mcp-bridge.description: The agent UI driver, consumed only in debug builds (the plugin is never initialised in release). Not on Windows, where the plugin isn't built (see Cargo.toml).

updater.description: In-app updates, offered from the operator window only: check for a newer release, download and install it, then relaunch. app:allow-version is for showing which version this is.
